label: Video Camera
depicts: Video camera body with two top circles and one side lens block on the right
use_when: Use when the interface wants the camera to feel like a classic film body with two circles on top.
avoid_when: Do not use for the simpler video camera when the top of the body should stay flat without twin circles.

label: Video Camera
depicts: Video camera body with one flat top block and one side lens block on the right
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simpler camera body without the twin circles of a film style recorder.
avoid_when: Do not use for the twin reel camera when the top of the body should show two round circles.

label: Voice
depicts: Five vertical bars centered around one tallest middle bar with shorter bars outside
use_when: Use when the interface wants the voice cue to read as a balanced centered waveform.
avoid_when: Do not use for the rising bar voice mark when the bars should climb unevenly from left to right.

label: Voice
depicts: Five vertical bars rising unevenly from left to right with the tallest bar near the right edge
use_when: Use when the interface wants the voice cue to read like an uneven equalizer that rises across the row.
avoid_when: Do not use for the centered waveform when the tallest bar should sit in the middle of a balanced pattern.

label: Wardrobe
depicts: Wardrobe body split into two tall doors with one small dot on each door
use_when: Use when the interface wants the wardrobe to read as two full height cabinet doors.
avoid_when: Do not use for the mixed wardrobe when one side should break into stacked shelf panels instead of two tall doors.
